best-cape-coral-insurance-agents.name: Cape Coral questions
best-cape-coral-insurance-agents.content_html:
YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

A little clarity
goes a long way.

What types of insurance do you offer?

As a Cape Coral Insurance Agency, we offer a range of insurance options to cater to your specific needs. These include homeowners, auto, life, boat, ATV, and motorhome insurance.

How can I get a quote for homeowners insurance?

You can obtain a personalized quote for homeowners insurance by visiting our website and filling out the online form. Alternatively, you can call our office to speak with an agent.

Get a Cape Coral Insurance Quote
How much does homeowners insurance cost in Cape Coral, FL?

The cost of homeowners insurance varies based on several factors, including the value of your home, its location, and the level of coverage you need. On average, homeowners insurance for a $150,000 house in Cape Coral is around $3,095 per year.

What does homeowners insurance cover?

Homeowners insurance typically covers damage to both the interior and exterior of your house from events like fire, hurricanes, vandalism, and theft. It can also provide liability coverage for injuries that occur on your property.

Do I need landlord insurance if I'm renting out my property?

Yes, if you are planning on renting out your property, it’s recommended to have landlord insurance. This type of insurance can protect you from financial losses related to rental properties.

Can I bundle different types of Cape Coral insurance together?

Absolutely! Bundling different types of insurance can often lead to discounts. Speak with one of our agents to discuss your options.

How can I make a claim?

If you need to make a claim, you can do so by calling the claims department for your carrier directly.

What is the process after I file a claim?

Once you file a claim, you will be assigned a claims adjuster to your case. They will review the details of the claim, assess the damage, and determine the amount of compensation.

privacy-policy-2.name: Privacy policy
privacy-policy-2.content_html:
ON THIS PAGE

Privacy PolicyInformation We CollectHow We Use Your InformationInformation Sharing and DisclosureData SecurityYour Privacy RightsChanges to This Privacy PolicyContact Us

Privacy Policy

Welcome to Aaspire Agency DBA Culbertson Agency. Your privacy is important to us, and we are committed to protecting it. This privacy policy outlines how we collect, use, and share your information when you visit our website or use our services. By using our website, you agree to the terms of this policy.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  1. Personal Information: This includes your name, address, phone number, email address, Social Security number, and other identifying information.
  2. Financial Information: Details such as your bank account number, credit card number, and payment history.
  3. Insurance Information: Information related to your insurance policies, claims history, and coverage details.
  4. Technical Information: Data such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, and usage patterns on our website.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Provide and manage your insurance policies and claims.
  • Communicate with you about your policy, claims, and other services.
  • Process payments and transactions.
  • Improve our website and services.
  • Comply with legal and regulatory requirements.

Information Sharing and Disclosure

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with:

  • Insurance companies and underwriters for policy and claims processing.
  • Service providers who assist us in business operations, such as payment processing and IT support.
  • Regulatory and legal authorities when required by law or to protect our rights and safety.

Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. These measures include physical, technical, and administrative safeguards. However, no data transmission over the Internet or storage system can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

Your Privacy Rights

As a resident of Florida, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you.
  • Request corrections to any inaccurate or incomplete information.
  • Opt-out of certain data collection and sharing practices.
  • Request the deletion of your personal information, subject to certain exceptions.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we are protecting your information.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

Aaspire Agency DBA Culbertson Agency

13099 S Cleveland Ave, Suite 310
Fort Myers, FL 33907

Phone: 239-210-7700

For email inquiries, please visit our Contact Us page.

Thank you for trusting Aaspire Agency DBA Culbertson Agency with your insurance needs. We are committed to protecting your privacy and providing you with exceptional service.
